changelog:
Initial beta release of Alibaba Cloud GA acceleration deployment skill.

- Enables step-by-step deployment and end-to-end configuration of Global Accelerator (GA) services on Alibaba Cloud.
- Supports scenarios including cross-border web/API acceleration, global gaming, and real-time audio/video transmission.
- Provides architecture overview, installation and authentication prerequisites, and RAM policy guidance.
- Enforces credential and parameter confirmation best practices for secure and accurate deployment.
- Details required pre-checks, including GA service activation and permission validation.
